reviewItem.question: Does "Fix handling of certificates with IP addresses in the `commonName` field; IP addresses are no longer added to the DNS `subjectAlternativeName` list and are…" mean a change to crd-field:cert-manager|group=cert-manager.io|kind=Certificate|path=spec.commonName (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: For Certificates whose commonName is an IP address, the IP is no longer added to the DNS subjectAlternativeName list and is instead added to ipAddresses.
